No user-rejected artist artworks (El Greco and Fra Angelico) are promoted for owner decision; they are merely retained as historical evidence with exclusion marker.
Every appointed Gospel subject and saint identity requires contextual scene check before a proposed image reaches the owner. Do not force photo review now.
No owner decisions overwritten, Calendar runtime changes, source downloads or new fee-bearing licences.
